##### Project general facts

Rijas Majan is a serene boutique hotel residence. Step into a space adorned with earthy tones, where soothing neutrals are accentuated by gentle pastel greens, infusing a touch of nature into every room. This subtle pop of color brings a refreshing energy, creating a harmonious balance between modern sophistication and natural tranquility. With clean lines and simple shapes ensuring a minimalistic design, the space breathes and invites you to unwind in style.

Rijas Majan offers a range of amenities designed to enhance your stay, including an outdoor cinema, an infinity pool, and smart house technology. Experience the convenience and luxury of smart tech amenities that elevate your stay to a new level of comfort and sophistication. The property offers a stay where the modern meets the timeless, and where the minimalist design is a canvas for your own journey.

Every residence at Rijas Majan is fully furnished, with furniture carefully selected to embody both style and comfort. Rattan furniture pieces add a touch of bohemian charm, seamlessly merging with the modern aesthetics. The interiors are designed to create an oasis of tranquility with a touch of bohemian allure, offering a space that transcends the ordinary and invites guests to unwind in style.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Majan, a district located at the heart of the large Dubailand community, this exceptional location is a perfect place for those looking for a buy-to-invest property. While the community is developing, apartment prices have not yet reached their maximum values, offering good discounts for off-plan housing units.

The location is distinguished by its strategic access to Al Ain, Sharjah, and Abu Dhabi via Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Ain Road. The area comprises residential complexes, iconic towers, hotels, and mixed-use units, while proximity to high-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, major amusement parks, and sports facilities adds to its appeal. Affordable rental rates attract locals and tourists who want to rent in a good area at a competitive price.

For those seeking a residence that embodies bohemian elegance, modern convenience, and strong investment potential, Majan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of affordability, accessibility, and a forward-thinking community makes it one of Dubai's most promising destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — connected, convenient and effortlessly refined.
